<details>

<blockquote>
<h2>inquirer@14.2.2</h2>
<p>The umbrella package, bundling <code>@inquirer/prompts</code> and <code>@inquirer/core</code>.</p>
<h3>What's new</h3>
<ul>
<li>Fixed a race where keystrokes batched in the same tick as the key that settled a prompt could still reach keypress handlers after the prompt was done, cancelled, or aborted (<code>@inquirer/core</code>, <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: redirect.github.com]">#2255</a>, closes <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: redirect.github.com]">#1816</a>).</li>
<li><code>confirm()</code> now trims surrounding whitespace from answers before matching yes/no keywords (<code>@inquirer/confirm</code>, <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: redirect.github.com]">#2254</a>).</li>
</ul>
<h3>Included</h3>
<ul>
<li><code>@inquirer/core@^12.0.3</code></li>
<li><code>@inquirer/prompts@^8.7.2</code></li>
</ul>
